title: User
description: A user in an identity store.

storeName.description: The name of the store in which this user resides.

status.description: The user's status: pending, active, locked or disabled.

extId.description: A unique ID of the user supplied by the customer.

type.description: A user type supplied by the customer.

locale.description: The user's locale. The default locale configured at the store level.

timezone.description: The user's timezone. The default timezone configured at the store level.

nationalities.description: A list of nationalities associated with the user.

summaryInfo.description: Summary information about items registered to the user.

lockedUntilDtm.description: If the user is currently locked, this is the time at which the lock will end.

lastAuthenticatedDtm.description: If the user has been authenticated, this is the time at which they were last authenticated.

AppkeySummary.description:
Summary information about an appkey registered to the user.

**NOTE** The device information is only available if the `DEVICE_INFO` extension is enabled in the appkey registration policy.

id.description: The database identifier of the entity

deviceId.description:
A unique identifier of the device on which the appkey is installed

**NOTE** This is actually an identifier of the client application in which the appkey has been created. It is only available if the `DEVICE_INFO` extension s enabled in the appkey registration policy.

deviceOs.description:
The device operating system, for example `iOS`.

**NOTE** Only available if the `DEVICE_INFO` extension is enabled in the appkey registration policy.

deviceType.description:
The device type: identifies the device make and model.

**NOTE** Only available if the `DEVICE_INFO` extension is enabled in the appkey registration policy.

deviceName.description:
The device name: the device name if one has been registered by the device owner.

**NOTE** Only available if the `DEVICE_INFO` extension is enabled in the appkey registration policy.

notificationToken.description: A push notification token provided by the device

invalidToken.description: Present and true if the push notification token has been used for a previous push notification and is marked as unusable (invalid or unregistered).

preferredDevice.description: Present and true if this is the preferred device to receive notifications for this app.

aaid.description: A unique identifier of the appkey type.

keyId.description: A unique identifier of the particular appkey credential.

lastAuthenticatedWithDtm.description: The time of the last authentication. If this appkey has not been used for authentication then this field is not present.

BiometricSummary.description: Summary information about a biometric registered to the user.

id.description: The database identifier of the entity

subtype.description: The biometric subtype, for example an algorithm identifier like `DFV6E`

lastAuthenticatedWithDtm.description: The time of the last authentication. If this biometric has not been used for authentication then this field is not present.

DocumentSummary.description:
Summary information about a document registered to the user.

**NOT USED IN THIS RELEASE**

id.description: The database identifier of the entity
The database identifier of the entity

policyName.description: Identifies the identity store passcode policy.

status.description: The status of the user passcode.

lastRenewedDtm.description: The last time the passcode was renewed. Only present if a renewal has occurred.

expirationDate.description: Expiration date for a passcode. Only required if regular renewals are enforced.

lastAuthenticatedWithDtm.description: The time of the last authentication. If this passcode has not been used for authentication then this field is not present.

PasskeySummary.description: Summary information about a passkey registered to the user.

id.description: The database identifier of the entity

aaguid.description: A unique identifier of the passkey type.

credentialId.description: A unique identifier of the particular passkey credential.

lastAuthenticatedWithDtm.description: The time of the last authentication. If this passkey has not been used for authentication then this field is not present.

name.description: The name of the passkey supplied when the passkey was registered.

SecretSummary.description:
Summary information about a secret registered to the user.

**NOT USED IN THIS RELEASE**

id.description: The database identifier of the entity
The database identifier of the entity

status.description: The status of the user TOTP.

issuer.description: The issuer of the user TOTP.

username.description: The user name label used for registering TOTP.

algorithm.description: The algorithm used to validate the authentication code.

activatedDtm.description: Date and time of the TOTP activation - this is time when first auth with TOTP happened and marked TOTP as active.

expirationDtm.description: Expiration dtm for the pending TOTPs - this is time before which is possible to activate pending TOTP.

lastAuthenticatedWithDtm.description: The time of the last authentication. If this TOTP has not been used for authentication then this field is not present.

TrustXLocale.description: Locale information. Exposes the language, country and variant locale components, for example `en_US_UNIX` contains these components as `en`, `US` and `UNIX` respectively.

UserLocks.description:
User lock information.

Describes locks at the user level and modality level. A user can have escalating temporary locks which come into effect after a certain number of consecutive authentication attempts. The number of locks and the lock durations are configured at the store level.

**NOTE**: Currently only user-level locking is supported with modality level locking planned for a later release.

lockCounter.description: The number of consecutive locks tagged for this user.

tempLockedAt.description: If the user is *temporarily* locked then this is the time at which the lock came into effect.

tempLockedUntil.description: If the user is *temporarily* locked then this is the time at which the lock ends.

lockedAt.description: If the user is *permanently* locked then this is the time at which the lock came into effect.

userModalityLocks.description:
Locking information related to particular authentication modalities.

**Not supported in this release**

UserModalityLock.description:
Modality lock information.

Describes locks at the modality level. A modality can have escalating temporary locks which come into effect after a certain number of consecutive authentication attempts. The number of locks and the lock durations are configured at the store level.

**NOTE**: Currently only user-level locking is supported with modality level locking planned for a later release.

lockCounter.description: The number of consecutive locks tagged for this modality.

tempLockedAt.description: If the modality is *temporarily* locked then this is the time at which the lock came into effect.

tempLockedUntil.description: If the modality is *temporarily* locked then this is the time at which the lock ends.

lockedAt.description: If the modality is *permanently* locked then this is the time at which the lock came into effect.

UserSummaryInfo.description: Summary information about items registered to the user such as biometrics, appkeys and passkeys.

biometrics.description: A list of biometrics registered to the user

documents.description:
A list of documents registered to the user
**NOT USED IN THIS RELEASE**

secrets.description:
A list of secrets registered to the user
**NOT USED IN THIS RELEASE**

passkeys.description: A list of passkeys registered to the user

appkeys.description: A list of appkeys registered to the user

totps.description: A list of TOTPs registered to the user

passcodes.description: A list of passcodes registered to the user
